targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN risk = 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (intersection_id) intersection_id, CASE WHEN signal_latency > 3 OR error_count >= 10 OR power_voltage < 210 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN signal_latency > 2 OR error_count >= 5 OR power_voltage < 220 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk FROM telemetry ORDER BY intersection_id, timestamp DESC) latest;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM intersections;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (intersection_id) intersection_id, CASE WHEN signal_latency > 3 OR error_count >= 10 OR power_voltage < 210 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN signal_latency > 2 OR error_count >= 5 OR power_voltage < 220 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk FROM telemetry ORDER BY intersection_id, timestamp DESC) latest WHERE risk <> 'LOW';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ai_analysis WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

SELECT i.id AS intersection, i.name, ROUND(t.traffic_volume::numeric, 0) AS traffic, ROUND(t.signal_latency::numeric, 2) AS latency_s, ROUND(t.power_voltage::numeric, 1) AS voltage_v, t.error_count AS errors, CASE WHEN t.signal_latency > 3 OR t.error_count >= 10 OR t.power_voltage < 210 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN t.signal_latency > 2 OR t.error_count >= 5 OR t.power_voltage < 220 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk, t.timestamp AS last_seen FROM intersections i JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM telemetry WHERE intersection_id = i.id ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) t ON true ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.signal_latency > 3 OR t.error_count >= 10 OR t.power_voltage < 210 THEN 1 WHEN t.signal_latency > 2 OR t.error_count >= 5 OR t.power_voltage < 220 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, i.id;

SELECT created_at AS time, intersection_id AS intersection, risk, provider, model, LEFT(REPLACE(analysis, E'\n', ' '), 240) AS ai_insight FROM ai_analysis WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, traffic_volume AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;
SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, signal_latency AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;
SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, power_voltage AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;
SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, error_count AS value FROM telemetry WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT i.name AS intersection, i.latitude, i.longitude, CASE WHEN t.signal_latency > 3 OR t.error_count >= 10 OR t.power_voltage < 210 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN t.signal_latency > 2 OR t.error_count >= 5 OR t.power_voltage < 220 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk, t.traffic_volume AS traffic, t.signal_latency AS latency, t.error_count AS errors FROM intersections i JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM telemetry WHERE intersection_id = i.id ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) t ON true;

title: CITYOS — The City That Fixes Itself
